integrity: Theorems are supported by explicit analytic arguments and a reproducibility script. Numerical tests only corroborate finite cases; historical originality is provisional and independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: A two-stage unidirectional continuous-time passage model with independent exponential mortality and traversal clocks, linear fixed sum of rate investments, and no feedback, alternate corridors or environmental heterogeneity. Finite-horizon uniqueness is proved only near short and long time limits; no field calibration, and no complete historical priority certificate.
title: Mortality-matched investment for serial habitat passage under arbitrary deadline rewards
